SHÙ Mandarin Number Gym — synthetic audio provenance

All 144 .m4a practice clips were generated offline specifically for this project.
Model: csukuangfj/icefall-tts-aishell3-vits-low-2024-04-06
Model card: https://huggingface.co/csukuangfj/icefall-tts-aishell3-vits-low-2024-04-06
Model license: Apache-2.0 (declared by the model author)
Training corpus: AISHELL-3, https://www.openslr.org/93/ (Apache-2.0)
Inference: sherpa-onnx 2.0.1, https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx (Apache-2.0)
Voice: synthetic AISHELL-3 speaker 66. No endorsement or real speaker identity is claimed.
The Apache-2.0 license is included in APACHE-2.0.txt.

These are synthetic training aids, not native-speaker recordings. The model uses
dictionary pronunciation; tonal sandhi and natural conversational rhythm may vary.
Prepared text and expected answers are defined in engine.js. No speech recognition,
voice recording, paid inference, or runtime model download is used in this app.

Fonts: DM Sans and Manrope, SIL Open Font License 1.1; licenses are in fonts/.
